concept: RDS Proxy: connection pooling for Lambda
tests: How to stop RDS connection exhaustion when every Lambda invocation opens a new connection.
expected: Amazon RDS Proxy — pools and reuses DB connections. Triggers: "Lambda", "connection exhaustion", "each invocation opens a new connection", "traffic spikes".
why_not: A bigger instance doesn't solve the connection limit; more Lambda concurrency only makes it worse; moving to DynamoDB is a major rewrite.
